title: Cypress Edge - tenant setup jot
body:
Context: Cypress Edge (fintech startup) wants Private (VPC) deployment in us-east-1. Customer constraints: no internet egress, HSM for keys, audit logs to their Splunk. Goal: minimal viable tenant to validate latency and model quality before large Dedicated commit.

Top-level plan (quick):
- Day 0: exchange VPC details + create VPC peering request
- Day 1: initial private control plane deploy (test account) -> smoke test generation + embeddings
- Day 2: enable KMS/HSM integration + audit log sink
- Day 3: canary rollout (5% traffic) with fallback to hosted small-model variant

Notes / commands / config snippets:
- Peer config: accept only 10.2.0.0/16 from cypress-prod-vpc; route table entry -> redwood-private-subnet (10.1.0.0/16)
- KMS alias: alias/redwood-cypress-edge-kms (customer to create, we provide policy template)
- HSM note: customer uses Thales Luna; need PKCS#11 connector v2.1 compatibility check (action: ask infra for test harness)
- Model pin: pin model to "vicuna-13b-q4_0" for canary; fallback to "redwood-small-1" if token queue > 300ms
- Estimated token burn for POC (30k daily requests @ avg 120 tokens gen + 50 tokens embed) ~ 5.1M tokens/day -> cost ballpark for POC: $X/day (fill after billing calc)

Immediate action items (me):
- [ ] Send VPC peering template to Customer (
- [ ] Share KMS/HSM policy + endpoint examples
- [ ] Open infra ticket to validate PKCS#11 connector against Luna (ENG-1429)
- [ ] Prepare quick smoke test script (curl + example prompt) + ephemeral api-key with 24h TTL

Customer questions to resolve (ask during next call):
1) Do they require inbound TLS client certs for control plane callbacks?
2) SLA expectations for token throughput and p99 latency
3) Compliance timeline for SOC2 / PCI implications if we host logs in Splunk (retention window)

Testing notes (observations):
- Local perf run (approx): 13b q4 model @ p100 on g5x ~ 14 tok/sec single-stream — need batching suggestion (suggest continuous batching up to 8 streams)
- Suggest autoscale policy: min pool 2 p100 nodes, scale metric = token-queue-length > 100 for 2m
- Canary scheduling: 48h with health checks every 5m; rollback on error-rate > 2% or latency regression > 20%

Conversation snippets (raw):
- Customer Slack: "we can't have outgoing connections from the VPC except to redwood-control.us-east-1" -> we must enumerate control-plane egress IPs
- Customer: "we want KMS to sign audit events" -> confirm KMS signing flows + sample key usage

Open blockers:
- HSM connector validation (blocked on infra test harness)
- Customer KMS alias creation (customer action)

Next meetings:
- Stand-up with infra + se (tomorrow 09:30 PT) to triage ENG-1429
- Customer call Wednesday 11:00 PT to confirm peering & KMS timeline

Random scratch reminders (to self):
- Drop a quick note in #se-oncall about control-plane egress IPs list
- Update POC billing calc spreadsheet after infra cost estimate posted (sheet id: confluence link above)

End of jot. Keep this lightweight — will convert to customer-facing checklist once blockers cleared.
